data.one_liner: Dart/Flutter client for Elastic App Search API
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple, type‑safe API to query Elastic App Search, filter results, and access metadata. It wraps HTTP calls and returns easy‑to‑use objects.
use_when: You need to integrate Elastic App Search into a Flutter app
You want a fluent query builder with filters, facets, and pagination
You prefer a single package that covers all App Search endpoints
avoid_when: You don't have an Elastic App Search deployment
You need offline or local search capabilities
strengths: Full native endpoint coverage for engine, account, and crawler APIs
Fluent query syntax with filters, facets, and pagination
Strong request validation and error mapping
Built with Dio for robust networking
weaknesses: Relies on Dio, so adding it to a project adds a dependency
data.setup_notes: Create an ElasticAppSearch instance with endpoint and searchKey, then call engine("name").query("term")…
data.minimal_example:
final service = ElasticAppSearch(
  endPoint: "https://host-2376rb.api.swiftype.com",
  searchKey: "search-371auk61r2bwqtdzocdgutmg",
);

ElasticResponse response = await service
  .engine("search-ui-examples")
  .query("mountains")
  .filter("states", isEqualTo: "California")
  .filter("world_heritage_site", isEqualTo: true)
  .resultField("title")
  .resultField("description", snippetSize: 140)
  .page(1, size: 50)
  .get();
